A '''cigarette''' was a type of [[Cigarra/Legends|cigarra]] made from a small roll of finely cut [[Tobacco/Legends|tobacco]] leaves wrapped in a cylinder of thin [[Paper/Legends|paper]] for [[Smoking/Legends|smoking]]. The cigarette was ignited at one end and allowed to smolder; its smoke was inhaled from the other end, which was held in the mouth.
